https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PokeAPI/sprites/master/sprites/pokemon/other/home/25.png

SHA256: `6a9305fbd6f02345153567f4142faf019380b1a1c839cfa3f2349cc36d536a40`.

No generated pixels or species/costume substitutions.
